sloka: एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तं वालिना रावणः प्रभो ।धर्षितश्च कृतश्चापि भ्राता पावकसन्निधौ ।। ७.३४.४५ ॥
transliteration: evametatpurāvṛttaṁ vālinā rāvaṇaḥ prabho ।dharṣitaśca kṛtaścāpi bhrātā pāvakasannidhau ।। 7.34.45 ॥

translations.english: O Lord, thus did this happen formerly: Ravana was humiliated by Vali and also made his brother in the presence of fire.
